purpose: Compare market-session-aligned intraday representations with nominal TradingView bins and daily representations for an independent scorer.

candidate_definitions.note: Actual XTKS sessions with unequal active durations; not equal-duration four-hour bars. Closing auction handling from 2024-11-05 is explicit.
Rebuilt only from raw intraday input; legacy special-construction bars are not used as model features.

candidate_definitions.definition: Daily OHLCV features as a separate candidate family.
Intraday features plus daily consistency checks and only signal-time-valid daily supplements; source-tag all reconstructed/validated fields.

input_requirement: Raw intraday observations fine enough to assign the 11:30/12:30 session boundary without splitting an already aggregated bar. Hourly data is accepted only if its timestamp and bar-interval semantics prove exact boundary alignment.
artifact_policy: Read raw inputs only; write fresh panels to separate ignored research artifacts with input hashes, transformation version, timezone, session calendar, and adjustment policy. Never mutate legacy data.

evaluation.candidate_pool: Same frozen symbol/session candidate pool across eligible representations.
evaluation.target: DAILY_ENDPOINT_TARGET_SPEC_V3.json; next official-session open to fifth-session close.
evaluation.metrics: Sample count, mean, median, win, +10/+20/+50, -10/-20, Top1/Top3 exclusion, month/week/symbol concentration, unresolved labels, and path/actionability separately.
evaluation.validation: Register features and bar definitions before outcome access; 2025/2026 report-only and unavailable for feature selection.

decision: No representation is promoted until an eligible raw intraday source and a fair same-candidate comparison are available.
